Question 13
?

Find the disjoint union of the sets A1={1,2,3} and A2={0,2}.

a
{(1,1),(2,1),(3,1),(0,2),(2,2)}
b
{0,1,2,3}
c
{(1,1),(2,1),(3,1),(0,1),(2,1)}
d
{(1,0),(2,0),(3,0),(1,2),(2,2),(3,2)}
e
{1,2,3}
